## Prefill-Decode Disaggregation

The GLM-5 model supports Prefill-Decode Disaggregation deployment,
where the pre-fill stage and decode stage are deployed on separate nodes.
The pre-fill stage handles prompt processing and computes the KV cache,
while the decode stage generates tokens autoregressively.

To deploy with disaggregation, configure the pre-fill node with:
